pairs: it is being said that there is fornication among you,
even fornication of a such kind that is not among the Gentiles,
ita ut uxorem patris sui aliquis habeat.
so that someone would have the wife of his father.
et non magis luctum habuistis ut tollatur de medio vestrum qui hoc opus fecit.
and you have not instead been grieved, so that he who has done this thing would be taken away from your midst.
I am present in spirit. Thus,
I have already judged, as if I were present,
in nomine Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
you have been gathered together with my spirit,
in the power of our Lord Jesus,
tradere hujusmodi Satanæ in interitum carnis,
to hand over such a one as this to Satan, for the destruction of the flesh,
ut spiritus salvus sit in die Domini nostri Jesu Christi.
so that the spirit may be saved in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
It is not good for you to glory.
Nescitis quia modicum fermentum totam massam corrumpit?
Do you not know that a little leaven corrupts the entire mass?
Expurgate vetus fermentum, ut sitis nova conspersio,
Purge the old leaven, so that you may become the new bread,
Etenim Pascha nostrum immolatus est Christus.
For Christ, our Passover, has now been immolated.
neque in fermento malitiæ et nequitiæ:
not with the leaven of malice and wickedness,
sed in azymis sinceritatis et veritatis.
but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
As I have written to you in an epistle:
certainly not with the fornicators of this world,
nor with the servants of idolatry.
alioquin debueratis de hoc mundo exiisse.
Otherwise, you ought to depart from this world.
Nunc autem scripsi vobis non commisceri:
But now I have written to you:
do not associate with anyone who is called a brother and yet is a fornicator,
With such a one as this,
Quid enim mihi de iis qui foris sunt, judicare?
For what have I to do with judging those who are outside?
nonne de iis qui intus sunt, vos judicatis?
But do not even you yourselves judge those who are inside?
But send this evil person away from yourselves.
